jsonld_raw.name: LUCE DI TOSCANA ITALIAN FIG & WOOD PARFUM 100ML
jsonld_raw.description:
LUCE DI TOSCANA ITALIAN FIG & WOOD PARFUM 100ML. The Art of Becoming, a collection inspired by the journey to your most authentic self. A sun-drenched morning. Cypress-lined paths, unhurried conversations, and the certainty that beauty is also found in the simplest moments. Primofiore lemon adds a luminous freshness that wraps around Italian fig, while blonde woods create a clean, modern, and serene finish.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Woody Fruity | Luminous, fresh, and contemporary
